OpenSearch disables shard slow logs by default. After you enable the publishing of shard slow
logs to CloudWatch, you still must specify logging thresholds for each OpenSearch index. These
thresholds deﬁne precisely what should be logged and at which log level.
For example, you can specify these settings through the OpenSearch REST API:
PUT domain-endpoint/index/_settings
{
"index.search.slowlog.threshold.query.warn": "5s",
"index.search.slowlog.threshold.query.info": "2s"
}

hierarchy.parent: Monitoring OpenSearch logs with Amazon CloudWatch Logs
